topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Objectives

topics.label: Cancer Etiology: Biological Concepts, Environmental Factors, and Epidemiology
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce the biological nature of cancer and explore how endogenous processes, environmental exposures, and genetic predispositions contribute to cancer development across populations.
